o1RootCause.explanation: The normal reviewer services already create durable reviewId/auditId records, but the factory-only R2-G3 provider invocation did not create a service record. The existing admin self-review record is also only partially identifying: it has run/scope/evidence checksums but no per-review execution ID or candidate/test binding. Therefore the missing closure is a bounded Factory-review evidence-contract/persistence composition gap, not a customer-production behavior defect.

preferredMinimalSolution: Extend the existing factory self-review admin artifact contract/producer so each bounded R2-G3 semantic reviewer result receives a host-generated reviewExecutionId and persists candidate, evidence-pack, test-execution, reviewer, result, verdict, finding, obligation, and currentness bindings in one machine-readable Phase 7B result. Reuse the existing admin-artifact authority; do not create a parallel database authority or synthetic customer project.

Build a new manifest-bound evidence pack and assign a new evidencePackId/checksum because the evidence identity changes.

Stop after the two required reviewer verdicts; no correction cycle or broad validation.
